subject: FireRouter with Opus
one_line: Production setup guide, cost trade-offs, and failure pitfalls for using Fireworks FireRouter with Claude Opus 5.5.

official_claims.savings: 57% lower cost per session compared to pure Claude Opus 5.5
official_claims.architecture: Dynamic cache-aware router dispatching turns across Claude Opus 5.5, GLM 5.3, and GLM 5.3 Flash
official_claims.cache_awareness: Estimates prompt cache preservation vs loss before routing to cheaper models

cursor.settings: OpenAI-compatible Base URL: https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1, Model: accounts/fireworks/models/firerouter-opus

empirical_risks.impact: Every turn evaluates model suitability and cache trade-offs, introducing 150-350ms added TTFT latency.
If GLM 5.3 intercepts multi-file architecture refactoring turns, subtle logic bugs can occur compared to pure Opus 5.5.

empirical_risks.risk: Cache Thrashing on Rapid Context Switches
empirical_risks.impact: If prompt prefixes oscillate, frequent model switching invalidates provider-side prompt caches, eroding the claimed 57% savings.
